title: Bind My Profile page and header avatar display data strictly to Firestore users/{uid}

requirements.summary: Update the existing My Profile page to display photo, full name, and email strictly from Firestore users/{uid} (photoURL/name/email) rather than any Firebase Auth fields.
acceptanceCriteria: On the My Profile page, the profile photo source is bound to `users/{uid}.photoURL` and the full name text is bound to `users/{uid}.name`.
On the My Profile page, the email address text is bound to `users/{uid}.email`.
The My Profile page does not use any Firebase Auth fields (e.g., auth user email/photo/displayName) for display values; displayed values come from Firestore profile data.
If Firestore `users/{uid}` exists, its `name/email/photoURL` values are shown on the My Profile page.

file_operations.description: Ensure all displayed profile values (avatar image, full name text, email text) are bound only to the Firestore-loaded `userProfile` fields (`photoURL`, `name`, `email`) returned by `useFirestoreUserProfile`, with no usage of Firebase Auth user fields for display.

requirements.summary: Implement deterministic avatar fallback on the My Profile page: show initials from Firestore name when photoURL is missing/empty, and do not attempt to load an image in that case.
acceptanceCriteria: When `photoURL` is an empty string or undefined, the My Profile avatar renders initials (derived from the Firestore `name`) rather than a broken/empty image.
When `photoURL` is a non-empty string, the My Profile avatar renders the image from Firestore.

file_operations.description: Update the Avatar rendering to conditionally render `AvatarImage` only when `userProfile.photoURL` is a non-empty string (e.g., trimmed), otherwise render only `AvatarFallback` with initials derived from `userProfile.name`.

requirements.summary: Update the existing header top-right avatar to use Firestore users/{uid}.photoURL with initials fallback from Firestore users/{uid}.name; do not use Firebase Auth for displayed profile fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Header avatar image source is `users/{uid}.photoURL` (from Firestore profile data).
If `photoURL` is empty/missing, the header avatar shows initials derived from Firestore `name` and does not attempt to load an empty image URL.
No header avatar display values (image/name/initials) are derived from Firebase Auth fields.

file_operations.description: Update the header Avatar to conditionally render `AvatarImage` only when Firestore `userProfile.photoURL` is non-empty; otherwise show `AvatarFallback` initials derived from Firestore `userProfile.name`, ensuring no Firebase Auth fields are used for any displayed avatar values.

requirements.summary: Ensure My Profile page and header avatar fetch and bind Firestore users/{uid} as the single source of truth (reading only name/email/photoURL for binding) and update UI to show Firestore data whenever it exists, without changing routes/navigation/layout.
acceptanceCriteria: With an existing Firestore doc `users/{uid}`, both My Profile and the header avatar display the Firestore `name/email/photoURL` values.
No routes/navigation, roles/approval logic, or UI layout/design are changed as part of this fix.

file_operations.description: Confirm the hook continues to fetch the current user's Firestore document (`users/{uid}`) and return Firestore-sourced profile data to consumers, without introducing any Firebase Auth fields for display binding; keep existing routing/guards unchanged.
Ensure the header continues to rely on `useFirestoreUserProfile` output for avatar binding so it reflects Firestore data whenever available, without altering navigation, route guards, or layout.

Ensure the My Profile screen continues to rely on `useFirestoreUserProfile` output for all displayed profile values so it reflects Firestore data whenever available, without altering navigation, route guards, or layout.
